name: aidp-benchmark
description: AIDP v1.0, the Agentic IDP Accuracy Standard: the specification, the AIDP-2K generator and answer keys, the scoring code and the published evidence.
//: Setup: npm ci, then npx playwright install chromium. The browser is needed only to draw the PDFs (npm run render) and the sample (bench/corpus-sample.mjs without --corpus).

mupdf is licensed GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later. It is needed by the AIDP-CAP generator (aidp-bench/corpus-gen/cap), which reads its drawn pages back and turns, rescans and joins PDFs with it, and by the benchmark tools that read PDF pages: the post-run diagnostics (aidp-bench/bench/post-run), the page previews of aidp-bench/bench/corpus-sample.mjs and the optional second-reader lane of aidp-bench/bench/run-das.mjs. Regenerating AIDP-2K and scoring do not use it.

npm run keys writes the answer keys, page texts, manifest.json and contract.json; npm run render draws the 2,012 PDFs. Both write to aidp-bench/corpus-regenerated unless given --out <dir> (npm run keys -- --out <dir>).

scripts.rescore: node aidp-bench/bench/score-run.mjs --corpus aidp-bench/corpus --tag aidp-v1-main --stability-tag aidp-v1-stability --rules-tag aidp-v1-rules --out aidp-bench/results/rescore
scripts.test: node aidp-bench/bench/test-scoring.mjs && node aidp-bench/bench/test-runner.mjs && node aidp-bench/bench/test-generator.mjs
scripts.rescore:heldout: node aidp-bench/bench/score-run.mjs --corpus aidp-bench/corpus-heldout --tag aidp-v1-heldout-main --stability-tag aidp-v1-heldout-stability --out aidp-bench/results/rescore-heldout
scripts.rescore:cap: node aidp-bench/bench/score-cap.mjs --corpus aidp-bench/corpus-cap --main aidp-bench/results/aidp-v1-cap-main --split aidp-bench/results/aidp-v1-cap-split --contract aidp-bench/results/aidp-v1-cap-contract --rules aidp-bench/results/aidp-v1-cap-rules --board aidp-bench/results/aidp-v1-main/scoreboard.json --out aidp-bench/results/rescore-cap --resamples 2000
